n03d1935e1e.headline: CMC Markets CEO Highlights Strategic Shift And B2B Growth Potential (LON:CMCX)
n03d1935e1e.summary: CMC Markets CEO Peter Cruddas described the company's move from a B2C model to a technology-driven B2B business, citing partnerships with Westpac, Revolut, ASB and Currys.
n03d1935e1e.why: CMC Markets is a London-listed online trading and fintech firm. Shifts in its business model affect its revenue mix and growth outlook.

n7b7392f90e.headline: De Wever: Ukraine funding failure would be EU disgrace, but still ‘no’ to using Russian assets
n7b7392f90e.summary: Belgian Prime Minister De Wever said a failure to fund Ukraine would be an EU disgrace but ruled out using Russian assets, ahead of a critical summit.
n7b7392f90e.why: Frozen Russian central bank assets are a key source of potential financing for Ukraine, and their use is a sensitive legal and financial question for EU members. Belgium hosts much of the relevant financial infrastructure.

n048a52d14f.headline: Lupin signs exclusive licensing pact with Neopharmed for plasil in Philippines and Brazil - CNBC TV18
n048a52d14f.summary: Lupin's Philippines subsidiary Multicare Pharmaceuticals and its Brazilian subsidiary MedQuimica will market Plasil under an exclusive licensing agreement with Neopharmed.
n048a52d14f.why: Lupin is an Indian generic pharmaceutical company with operations in emerging markets. Licensing deals expand its branded product sales across regions.

nc3db134fd1.headline: Botswana and KP Energy sign MoU to develop large-scale renewable energy
nc3db134fd1.summary: Botswana and KP Energy signed a memorandum of understanding to develop large-scale renewable energy. The collaboration is expected to require capital investment of approximately $4 billion.
nc3db134fd1.why: Large renewable projects attract international capital and can reshape a country's energy mix and power supply.

ncd0d757735.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Rises 0.20% – European Markets Gain
ncd0d757735.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange opened with a 0.20% gain amid positive movement across European markets. Key stocks and indices showed modest upward trends.
ncd0d757735.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's national equity market, and its moves reflect domestic and European investor sentiment.

nadc7605cbf.headline: Wildlife groups hit back at nuclear review claims over Hinkley Point C
nadc7605cbf.summary: Environmental organisations have criticised the government's Nuclear Review, known as the Fingleton Report, for suggesting that environmental protections should be weakened for the Hinkley Point C project.
nadc7605cbf.why: Hinkley Point C is a major nuclear power station under construction in Somerset, England. Government nuclear policy and planning rules affect the cost, timing and financing of new low-carbon power.

nbb162e6f9d.headline: Africa: South Africa Inflation Slows in November, Boosting Rate-Cut Bets
nbb162e6f9d.summary: South Africa's annual inflation slowed more than expected in November, strengthening the case for an interest-rate cut early next year. The central bank is shifting toward a lower inflation target.
nbb162e6f9d.why: The South African Reserve Bank sets the country's policy rate, and inflation data guides rate expectations that influence the rand and local bond yields.

n9a8ffde985.headline: Reeves’s planning overhaul stalls as UK’s senior adviser leaves after four months.
n9a8ffde985.summary: Catherine Howard, the UK government's senior adviser, has left after four months, amid disagreements over how far to push the deregulation agenda. Chancellor Rachel Reeves's planning overhaul has stalled.
n9a8ffde985.why: Planning reform determines how quickly housing and infrastructure projects can be built in the UK. Investors in construction and infrastructure watch these rules closely.

nefb205aaaa.headline: National Transmission Company South Africa provides update on Mozal, Mozambique, aluminium smelter new electricity supply agreement negotiations – Unabridged
nefb205aaaa.summary: South Africa's NTCSA, an Eskom subsidiary, updated on negotiations over a new electricity supply agreement for the Mozal aluminium smelter in Mozambique. The company said it remains committed to the talks.
nefb205aaaa.why: Mozal is a major aluminium smelter whose power costs depend on long-term supply contracts, which matter for aluminium output and regional power markets.

nf58171ed88.headline: Rai Way leads the way
nf58171ed88.summary: Rai Way reported a solid nine-month performance for FY 25, driven by traditional business growth and disciplined cost management. Strategic diversification was also noted.
nf58171ed88.why: Rai Way is an Italian tower infrastructure operator that leases telecom sites to mobile network operators, so its results track wireless infrastructure demand.

n80f7b017f7.headline: New Czech government looking at several CEZ buyout options, minister says
n80f7b017f7.summary: The new Czech government is examining several options for buying out utility CEZ, including leaving some assets listed. No deadline has been set for a decision.
n80f7b017f7.why: CEZ is the Czech state-controlled power utility, and a buyout would change its ownership, listing status and the state's role in the country's power sector.

impacts.name: CEZ
impacts.why: A state buyout of the listed utility would change its free float and ownership structure, though terms are not yet set.

na8ec3d2bd8.headline: Bolivia president removes fuel subsidies
na8ec3d2bd8.summary: Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz said the government would remove long-standing fuel subsidies in a bid to shore up public accounts. Paz took office last month.
na8ec3d2bd8.why: Fuel subsidies are a large item in government spending, and their removal changes domestic fuel prices and the fiscal balance of an economy.

n90f8cc0a27.headline: 3% increase in agricultural prices in 2025
n90f8cc0a27.summary: Early estimates show the average price of EU agricultural output rose 3% in 2025 versus 2024. Input prices increased by less than 1%, reversing a slight decline in 2024.
n90f8cc0a27.why: Farm-gate prices drive incomes for agricultural producers and feed into food inflation across the European Union.

n556819e05e.headline: New deal needed for ‘bewildered and frightened’ farming sector, review urges
n556819e05e.summary: A government-commissioned review by former National Farmers' Union president Baroness Minette Batters urges a new deal for a farming sector described as bewildered and frightened. The report was delivered to the UK Government.
n556819e05e.why: Agricultural policy and support payments affect farm incomes, land values and food supply costs in the United Kingdom.

n7439a7bd3f.headline: ‘Money today or blood tomorrow’: EU leaders race to secure deal for Ukraine
n7439a7bd3f.summary: EU leaders are divided at a summit over a loan for Ukraine secured against Russian assets. Belgium is seeking guarantees in case the scheme goes wrong.
n7439a7bd3f.why: Frozen Russian central bank assets are largely held in the EU, mainly in Belgium through the Euroclear clearing house, so their use directly affects European financial institutions and sovereign risk.

n9bb246e1b6.headline: Asian stocks today: Markets trade in red amid AI concerns; Nikkei sheds over 400 points
n9bb246e1b6.summary: Asian stocks tumbled, mirroring a decline on Wall Street, as investors worried about high technology valuations and heavy AI spending. The Nikkei shed more than 400 points.
n9bb246e1b6.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's main benchmark index, and Asian markets often track Wall Street and the global technology sector.
n9bb246e1b6.why_moved: Investors grew concerned about high technology-sector valuations and heavy AI spending, and Asian shares followed a decline on Wall Street.

n414bab5af3.headline: MHP posts higher Q3 profit despite Ukraine war
n414bab5af3.summary: MHP posted higher third-quarter profit despite the war in Ukraine. Chicken demand supported results as output fell at home.
n414bab5af3.why: MHP is a large Ukrainian poultry producer that exports chicken products, so its results reflect both wartime production constraints and export demand.

n574a1d64eb.headline: 3 energy firms confirm they will cut £150 off all bills in the new year
n574a1d64eb.summary: Three energy firms have confirmed that fixed-deal customers will automatically receive the £150 Budget saving in the new year. The measure applies to bills in the UK.
n574a1d64eb.why: Household energy bills are set partly by suppliers' tariffs and government policy, and they feed into UK inflation and consumer spending.

n0ffdb6f401.headline: INTERVIEW: Nigeria's electricity generation, transmission have improved under Tinubu - Minister Adelabu
n0ffdb6f401.summary: Nigerian Minister Adelabu said electricity generation and transmission have improved under the Tinubu administration. He acknowledged that significant challenges persist in the sector.
n0ffdb6f401.why: Power supply reliability is a key constraint on industrial output and investment in Nigeria's economy.

n46b1f3e0f2.headline: Trump’s Tanker Blockade Leaves Venezuela Running Out of Oil Storage
n46b1f3e0f2.summary: Venezuela may soon have to close some oil wells as it runs low on storage capacity after last week's tanker seizure. US plans to block other sanctioned vessels add pressure.
n46b1f3e0f2.why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest proven crude reserves, so disruptions to its exports affect global crude supply and prices.
n46b1f3e0f2.why_moved: Seized tankers and planned US blocks on sanctioned vessels limit Venezuela's ability to ship crude, leaving little storage room for ongoing output.

n7301295afa.headline: Nigeria and the ‘Narrow Corridor’: What Africa’s largest refinery says about power, accountability, development
n7301295afa.summary: Mr Dangote accused the head of a key regulatory agency, Farouk Ahmed, of living far beyond his official income. The remarks involve Africa's largest refinery.
n7301295afa.why: Dangote Refinery in Lagos is Africa's largest single-site refinery, and its relations with regulators affect Nigeria's fuel supply and downstream market.

n77b442b272.headline: North Korea-Linked Hackers Steal $2.02 Billion in 2025, Leading Global Crypto Theft
n77b442b272.summary: Chainalysis reports North Korea-linked hackers stole $2.02 billion in crypto in 2025, accounting for most global thefts and major exchange breaches.
n77b442b272.why: Crypto exchanges and custodians hold large pooled balances, so large hacks raise security costs, insurance needs and regulatory scrutiny across the sector.

n74332359fc.headline: Hawaiian, Alaska airlines to use locally made biofuel
n74332359fc.summary: Hawaiian Airlines and Alaska Airlines expect to begin running some planes partly on biofuel produced in Hawaii early next year.
n74332359fc.why: Alaska Air Group owns Hawaiian Airlines, and airlines' fuel costs are a major share of operating expenses, so fuel sourcing matters to their margins.

nd4e123437c.headline: Belgium demands ironclad guarantees of protection as EU considers Ukraine loan
nd4e123437c.summary: Belgium fears Russia would retaliate and prefers the EU borrow the money on international markets rather than use other mechanisms. It demands ironclad guarantees of protection before agreeing.
nd4e123437c.why: EU financing decisions for Ukraine involve joint borrowing and member-state guarantees, which affect EU bond markets and fiscal exposure. Belgium hosts major EU institutions and the Euroclear clearing house.

n435067dea4.headline: Heating Prices Surge as Utility Bills Grow Faster Than Paychecks
n435067dea4.summary: NEADA found the average monthly US electric bill has surged 29% since 2021. Natural gas costs have jumped 50% over the past year, outpacing paycheck growth.
n435067dea4.why: Household energy costs influence consumer spending, inflation and political pressure on utilities and regulators. Natural gas prices are tied to power generation and heating demand.

ne3ec0d1db8.headline: Gamuda’s Australian JV wins RM2.69bil package
ne3ec0d1db8.summary: Gamuda says the TasVic Greenlink joint venture with Samsung C&T has been awarded the balance of works package for the Marinus Link project. The contract is worth RM2.69 billion.
ne3ec0d1db8.why: Gamuda is a Malaysian engineering and construction group whose contract wins in Australia add to its overseas infrastructure order book.

n3325d9f72b.headline: Regional bank pinged over money laundering guardrails
n3325d9f72b.summary: Regulatory action is being taken against a major regional bank after it self-reported suspected money laundering in its operations. The bank is not named in the available description.
n3325d9f72b.why: Money laundering enforcement can bring fines, remediation costs and compliance obligations for banks, which affects their earnings and regulatory standing.

n4c02a34c0c.headline: Big central banks tilt towards hiking mode as inflation nerves rise
n4c02a34c0c.summary: Central banks in major economies are signalling a change of stance, with many now on hold after a long easing cycle. Inflation worries are growing.
n4c02a34c0c.why: Central bank policy rates set the cost of borrowing across economies and drive government bond yields, currencies and equity valuations.
n4c02a34c0c.why_moved: Signals that major central banks may shift from easing to hiking reprice expectations for interest rates. Rising inflation concerns make that shift more plausible.

n9915cff862.headline: UBS Plans January Job Cuts to Start Final Integration Year
n9915cff862.summary: UBS plans job cuts in January to begin the final year of integrating Credit Suisse. Headcount swelled to 120,000 after the government-brokered takeover and has already fallen by 15,000.
n9915cff862.why: UBS is Switzerland's largest bank, and its 2023 takeover of Credit Suisse created one of the largest integration projects in European banking.

n3a43a89e85.headline: In White House speech, Trump highlights victories amid sinking approval ratings
n3a43a89e85.summary: In a rare evening White House address, Trump highlighted his accomplishments and blamed his predecessor for soaring consumer prices. His party faces a tough midterm election next year.
n3a43a89e85.why: Consumer price levels and political direction in the United States influence Federal Reserve policy, fiscal expectations and sentiment in US markets.

n65987eb79b.headline: US Energy Department signs AI collaboration deals with Big Tech for Genesis Mission
n65987eb79b.summary: The US Energy Department said it signed agreements with 24 organisations, including Microsoft, Google and Nvidia, to advance the Genesis Mission.
n65987eb79b.why: Government partnerships with large AI and cloud providers shape demand for AI infrastructure and the competitive position of major technology firms.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Named as a partner in a government AI collaboration agreement.

ncfc1c483d8.headline: Nike outperforms on topline but China EBIT misses estimates
ncfc1c483d8.summary: Nike reported second-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street revenue expectations, though earnings per share fell. Operating profit in China missed estimates.
ncfc1c483d8.why: Nike is a global sportswear company, and its China business is a significant source of sales and profit.

ne49ee1217f.headline: Recession Over: Economic Upswing for Austria Expected in 2026
ne49ee1217f.summary: Wifo and IHS slightly raised their forecasts, expecting Austrian economic growth of 0.5% in 2025 and up to 1.2% in 2026, alongside falling inflation and an easing labour market.
ne49ee1217f.why: WIFO and IHS are Austria's leading economic research institutes, and their forecasts guide expectations for growth, inflation and fiscal planning.

n48b35c77c6.headline: Germany launches 30 billion euro fund to mobilise private investment
n48b35c77c6.summary: Germany launched its 30 billion euro Deutschlandfonds initiative on Thursday. The programme aims to boost competitiveness by mobilising private capital for the economy.
n48b35c77c6.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and state-backed investment funds can influence capital flows into domestic infrastructure and industry.

n14057d62ba.headline: Accenture :  First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Presentation
n14057d62ba.summary: Accenture released its first quarter fiscal 2026 earnings presentation on December 18, 2025, outlining its Q1 FY26 performance. The presentation contained no further figures in the input.
n14057d62ba.why: Accenture is a global IT services and consulting firm, and its results are read as a bellwether for enterprise technology and consulting demand.

n7ad43bb272.headline: Wedbush: GM better positioned than peers as EV demand cools
n7ad43bb272.summary: Wedbush said General Motors is better positioned than peers, as it leans on its gasoline-powered vehicle business while recalibrating electric vehicle ambitions amid cooling EV demand.
n7ad43bb272.why: General Motors is one of the largest US automakers, and its mix of combustion and electric vehicles reflects broader industry adjustments to EV demand.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: The analyst view concerns GM's strategy relative to peers as EV demand cools.

n17e6794fe2.headline: British energy giant BP extends shakeup as picks new CEO - Latest News
n17e6794fe2.summary: BP has appointed outsider Meg O'Neill as chief executive from April, replacing Murray Auchincloss, who stepped down on Dec. 18. The company earlier this year shelved its carbon emissions reduction targets.
n17e6794fe2.why: BP is a major London-listed integrated oil and gas company, so leadership changes and strategy shifts affect its investment direction and shareholder returns.

n8c31e66ad4.headline: Michael Burry Asks For Photos Of Warehoused Nvidia GPUs After Analyst Questions Jensen Huang
n8c31e66ad4.summary: Investor Michael Burry asked for evidence of stockpiled Nvidia GPUs after an analysis on X questioned whether Jensen Huang's claims about shipments were accurate. Nvidia shipped GPU dies in 2025.
n8c31e66ad4.why: Nvidia designs the AI accelerator chips that drive much of current data center spending, making its shipment figures closely watched by investors.

nf0e5c1c35f.headline: Tensions boil over at farming protest in Brussels against EU
nf0e5c1c35f.summary: Tensions boiled over at a farming protest in Brussels against the EU. The president of the Irish Farmers Association travelled to Brussels to stand with colleagues from across Europe.
nf0e5c1c35f.why: EU agricultural policy sets subsidies and trade rules that directly affect food producers, food prices and agri-food company margins.

n67db35cbfe.headline: Accenture :  First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Earnings Press Release
n67db35cbfe.summary: Accenture reported financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026, ended November 30, 2025, compared with the first quarter of fiscal 2025.
n67db35cbfe.why: Accenture is a global IT services and consulting firm, and its quarterly results indicate demand for digital and AI-related corporate services.

n0c65f68c58.headline: Pag-IBIG Fund, Megawide partnership to build over 7,000 socialized homes
n0c65f68c58.summary: Pag-IBIG Fund has partnered with Megawide Construction to accelerate delivery of 7,143 housing units under the Expanded 4PH programme.
n0c65f68c58.why: Pag-IBIG is the Philippines' state housing fund, and government housing programmes create construction demand for contractors such as Megawide.

n2d665e7a6c.headline: EU leaders gather to discuss a massive loan to Ukraine
n2d665e7a6c.summary: European Union leaders are meeting to decide how to finance Ukraine so it can keep fighting Russia's invasion. Frozen Russian assets are among the options under discussion.
n2d665e7a6c.why: The EU is Ukraine's largest financial backer, and how it funds Kyiv affects sovereign financing, European budgets and sanctions policy.

ncc005484f6.headline: Russia has few legal options to challenge EU frozen asset plan
ncc005484f6.summary: European Union leaders are discussing whether to use frozen Russian assets to help Ukraine. A core question is whether the idea is legally sound, and Russia has few legal options to challenge it.
ncc005484f6.why: Frozen Russian central bank assets held largely in Europe are a sensitive sovereign and legal issue that affects financial markets, sanctions policy and EU financial institutions.

n6a334ea252.headline: Farm Fresh profits to rise
n6a334ea252.summary: CGS International Research says Farm Fresh Bhd's biggest driver of revenue growth is its ice cream business under the Cream Hauz brand.
n6a334ea252.why: Farm Fresh is a Malaysian dairy producer, so its revenue mix and growth drivers shape how investors assess its earnings outlook.

nd3e8ad0946.headline: Gold Rates in Pakistan Today - Gold Price Live Updates - 18 December 2025
nd3e8ad0946.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan were Rs453,562 per tola and Rs388,856 per 10 grams during the 18 December 2025 trading session in Karachi.
nd3e8ad0946.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and local prices reflect global bullion rates adjusted for the rupee exchange rate.

nbe0730a018.headline: Japan signals FX vigilance, leans against yen weakness with verbal intervention
nbe0730a018.summary: Japanese officials signalled vigilance on yen weakness through verbal intervention. Analysts say sustained stabilisation will depend on Bank of Japan policy signals and global rate dynamics.
nbe0730a018.why: The yen is a major global funding and reserve currency, and Japanese authorities closely watch its level because it affects import costs, inflation and corporate earnings.
nbe0730a018.why_moved: Verbal intervention from officials signals possible action against yen weakness, which can prompt traders to unwind dollar-yen long positions.

n29e1bb326f.headline: Taiwan’s economy is doing well, but many of its workers are not
n29e1bb326f.summary: Taiwan's economy is performing well, but many workers are not sharing in the gains, with a widening income gap. The article says this could hurt the ruling party at the 2028 presidential election.
n29e1bb326f.why: Income inequality shapes consumer demand, labour costs and political risk, all of which matter for investors in Taiwan.

ndabdbaf385.headline: Asahi Shares Fall After $3 Billion Deal for Diageo's East African Assets
ndabdbaf385.summary: Asahi Group's stock fell after the Japanese brewer agreed to buy Diageo's East Africa businesses in a $3 billion deal. The article notes the shares of the maker of ... fell as well.
ndabdbaf385.why: Asahi is a Japanese brewer and Diageo is the Guinness maker, so the deal moves beer and spirits assets between major global drinks companies.
ndabdbaf385.why_moved: Asahi shares fell after the company said it would pay $3 billion for Diageo's East African businesses, a deal investors appear to have received negatively.

ne7ee07f65c.headline: NBR moves to shift VAT on LPG at import stage to cut tax evasion
ne7ee07f65c.summary: Bangladesh's National Board of Revenue plans to shift VAT on LPG to the import stage to curb tax evasion. Officials say the change would let businesses offer price reductions to customers.
ne7ee07f65c.why: LPG is a widely used cooking fuel, and changes to its tax collection affect fuel prices, import businesses and government revenue.

n61b9faac6b.headline: PAGCOR revokes provisional license of Mactan casino project
n61b9faac6b.summary: The Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corp. revoked the provisional licence issued to subsidiaries of PH Resorts Group for its Emerald Bay project in Cebu. The group is led by Davao businessman Dennis Uy.
n61b9faac6b.why: Gaming licences are required to operate casinos and integrated resorts, so revocations directly affect project timelines and investment in the sector.

n51a5c66905.headline: Premium Brands Holdings Corporation Announces the Acquisition of Stampede Culinary Partners and Concurrent Equity and Convertible Debenture Offerings
n51a5c66905.summary: Premium Brands Holdings announced the acquisition of Stampede Culinary Partners alongside concurrent equity and convertible debenture offerings. The CEO cited prior investments in U.S. production capacity.
n51a5c66905.why: Premium Brands is a Canadian food company that makes and distributes branded and customized meat and protein products, and it funds deals through equity and debt.

n3a192727ab.headline: Quesnel council on track to support North Vancouver-Prince George railroad
n3a192727ab.summary: Quesnel council is on track to back the North Vancouver to Prince George railroad, amid concerns about the effect on the local economy, including tourism. The rail link is seen as important for maintaining freight connections.
n3a192727ab.why: Rail links carry freight for resource industries in northern British Columbia, so service continuity affects regional trade and logistics costs.

n4c2d0728d1.headline: Thunderbird Shareholders Question Blue Ant Buyout Terms
n4c2d0728d1.summary: Thunderbird shareholders are questioning the proposed Blue Ant buyout, with debate centred on valuation, control and whether the offer reflects Thunderbird's long-term worth. Atomic Cartoons is central to the deal.
n4c2d0728d1.why: Takeover bids are assessed on price and control terms, and shareholder pushback can affect whether a deal is approved or revised.

n3184b7f444.headline: TSX, U.S. markets gain ground Thursday following U.S. inflation report
n3184b7f444.summary: Stock markets in Canada and the U.S. rose on Thursday following the release of key U.S. economic data. The gains followed the U.S. inflation report.
n3184b7f444.why: The Toronto Stock Exchange is Canada's main equity market, and U.S. inflation data shapes expectations for Federal Reserve interest-rate decisions that affect global markets.
n3184b7f444.why_moved: U.S. economic data released Thursday was reported to have lifted both Canadian and U.S. stock markets.

n2bb51fb9d1.headline: Market Outlook: Santa Claus rally emerges as inflation cools
n2bb51fb9d1.summary: U.S. inflation cooled in November, lifting stocks and reinforcing rate-cut expectations. Investors are bracing for volatility in 2026.
n2bb51fb9d1.why: U.S. inflation readings guide Federal Reserve rate policy, which influences borrowing costs and equity valuations worldwide.
n2bb51fb9d1.why_moved: U.S. inflation cooled in November, which lifted stocks and reinforced expectations of interest-rate cuts.

nf60ad6a319.headline: Toronto Stocks Rally; BRP Shares Fall on Australian Telwater Unit Sale Block by Regulators
nf60ad6a319.summary: BRP shares fell after regulators blocked the sale of its Australian Telwater unit. Toronto stocks rallied in step with U.S. markets on Thursday.
nf60ad6a319.why: BRP is a Quebec-based maker of recreational vehicles and powersports engines, and regulatory approval of asset sales affects its strategy and value.

nd695cc7c38.headline: 3 unemployed people for every vacant job in Canada: StatCan
nd695cc7c38.summary: Canada had 3.3 unemployed persons for every job vacancy in October, Statistics Canada reported Thursday. The unemployment rate was 6.9 per cent.
nd695cc7c38.why: Statistics Canada is the national statistical agency, and labour market data informs Bank of Canada interest-rate decisions and economic outlooks.

n4f9a331dd1.headline: Feds moving forward on long-awaited sustainable investment guidelines
n4f9a331dd1.summary: The federal government says it is moving forward on a long-awaited central list of investments considered to be sustainable. No timeline was given in the input.
n4f9a331dd1.why: A sustainable investment taxonomy defines which investments qualify as green or sustainable, shaping capital flows and disclosure rules for investors.
